description: Local Hugging Face cache for zai-org/SWE-Dev-train, used as an allowed source for 48h pre-experiment SFT data materialization.
offline_load_hint: The cache is read-only and the hub is unreachable. Load from snapshot_path -- load_dataset('parquet', data_files=snapshot_path + '/data/sft-*.parquet') -- never by repo id, and never from blobs/, where the sft and rft files are indistinguishable.
materialize_hint: Use only this local HF cache as a source for derived training JSONL files. Do not copy this cache into the agent workspace and do not download missing data from inside the agent run.
